name: ontology
paper: Motger, Oriol, Marco, and Franch. Multi-Agent Debate Strategies: Survey, Taxonomy, and Challenges. arXiv:2607.26212v1.

debaters.background: Orders, quotes, and the customer who placed them
debaters.stance: A sale is a commitment to a customer. Booked value exists before an invoice. Quote-to-order is a sales fact.

debaters.background: Invoices, tax, credit, receivables, and legal-entity boundaries
debaters.stance: External revenue exists when it is invoiced. Consignment, intercompany, and exempt jurisdictions are not the same as a taxed external sale. A balance is not a flow.

debaters.background: On-hand stock, shipments, receipts, and consignment
debaters.stance: Stock moves on shipment and receipt, not when an order is booked. Goods shipped on consignment and not yet invoiced are still inventory.

debaters.background: Purchases, receipts, and the buying legal entity
debaters.stance: A purchase belongs to the entity that buys. An intercompany sale has to match that purchase, and the buyer's side is not the seller's revenue.

debaters.background: Completion, availability, and demand placed on the plant
debaters.stance: A good is available when production completes it, not when sales promises it. Booked demand is not finished goods.
